title: Preserve fresh-input stability and a reserved joint law kernel
statement: For the legal heat action J_s and fresh two-action word A,common-seed input perturbations obey E||J(v)-J(w)||^2<=12L^2||v-w||^2 and E||A(v)-A(w)||^2<=144L^4||v-w||^2. With independent nu-Gaussian reserve,the joint kernel retaining(T,W,V) and output tau V+alpha A_(g,x)(V)+nu N is TV-Lipschitz in available center x,constant 2c1+(1+sqrt(12))c1^3|alpha|L^2/nu,c1=sqrt(2/pi).

requires: Available centers/perturbations fixed before fresh standard Gaussian V and internal action seeds
s>0 for fixed-time estimates;Brownian center x+sqrt(T)W uses the proved integrable time bound
provides: Dimension-free mean-square INPUT direction stability,not uniformly bounded sample Jacobians
Full joint center-law bound retains Gaussian input,baseline and Brownian anchors
Applicable conditionally on independent prior state;no conditional Gaussian-output claim
assumptions: Internal perpendicular/radial seeds and endpoints are NOT retained
Perturbations selected using those fresh seeds invalidate the particular bound
Covariance interpretation needs conservative g;stability itself only uses global Lipschitzness
costs: At most4 original values plus O(d) work/storage for the word
Every nu reserve consumes target covariance
Center/full-seed source-energy bounds can scale as d^2 and need not integrate over time at L2 level
contract.units: Input mean-square stability and joint retained-state TV
contract.obstruction: Useful law-kernel interface,not an acquired posterior,intrinsic-law Poincare certificate or complete later nonlinear-circuit operations.

evidence.range_scope: Fresh input L2 stability and Gaussian-reserved center-law kernels with precise retained-state exclusions.

evidence.quote: No core mathematical blocker was found.
evidence.range_scope: Completed same-informed-peer static mathematical/acquisition reconstruction of the exact five proof hashes and both code files;missing historical audits/diagnostics remain unverified.

body: Perpendicular fresh-seed integration by parts proves the law bound. Revealing those same internal seeds would change its test space and lose this proof.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
